plan: bioinf2027/plans/D1b.md, Sections 1 to 12: the addendum of Section 7 and the changes after the four plan reviews, Sections 8 to 12
paths_relative_to: $IGA_STORAGE_ROOT for data-root files; the repository root for every other path

vcc_feature_shards.listing_format: relative path, bytes, sha256, one file per line, sorted

RPE1.route: repeated pass over the single-cell file

K562-essential.route: retained accumulator state, recomputed in this run
K562-essential.formula: mu_nt = nt_sum / nt_count, the plain mean, matching finalize(use_compensated=False)

cells_per_construct_against_n_perturbed_.rule: exact equality construct by construct; a difference is reported and the definition of the external own delta is replaced by the measured one (bioinf2027/plans/D1b.md, Section 12.2, item 8)

RPE1.source: gene and gene_transcript annotations with the pass's group definition; no expression value read
RPE1.rule: exact equality construct by construct; a difference is reported and the definition of the external own delta is replaced by the measured one (bioinf2027/plans/D1b.md, Section 12.2, item 8)

K562-essential.rule: exact equality construct by construct; a difference is reported and the definition of the external own delta is replaced by the measured one (bioinf2027/plans/D1b.md, Section 12.2, item 8)

rpe1_against_k562.unit: constructs of the target genes shared by both screens; one joint draw of shared genes

reading_by_call.positive: on shared target genes the control-cell mean rank-predicts the label more strongly on RPE1; the paper reports the cell lines separately
reading_by_call.negative: on shared target genes the control-cell mean rank-predicts the label more weakly on RPE1; the paper reports the cell lines separately
reading_by_call.inconclusive: no difference between the cell lines is resolved and the interval bounds it; no statement that they agree

rpe1_against_k562.reading_for_this_call: on shared target genes the control-cell mean rank-predicts the label more strongly on RPE1; the paper reports the cell lines separately
rpe1_against_k562.reading: a replication in a second cell line whose direction was foreseeable from the K562-essential value and from RPE1's own-delta association; not an independent confirmation

rpe1_pass.run_time: bioinf2027/runs/D1b.json, the run of that script

vcc_control_mean_noise.external: assumption, not computed: the pooled control sets hold 11,485 (RPE1) and 10,691 (K562-essential) cells, so the sampling noise of a pooled control mean is small against the spread across genes

masking_contrast.primary: plain minus target-zeroed max |x|, cell-level input, all eligible constructs, subset all, one per screen; fixed before its values were computed (Section 12.1)
masking_contrast.secondary: the release input and the in-feature subset, not adjusted for multiplicity

readings.masking lowers the score: part of the max-response secondary's external rank correlation comes from the target's own coordinate
readings.masking raises it: where the target coordinate is the largest, it ranks constructs worse than the next-largest coordinate does; the secondary's external score does not rest on the target coordinate
readings.no change resolved: no change resolved; the interval bounds the change; no statement that the score does not use the coordinate

masked_score_readings.positive: max |x| ranks constructs above chance without the target coordinate; whether that is response or sampling depth is read with the partial given log pool size
masked_score_readings.inconclusive: no external rank association is resolved without the target coordinate
masked_score_readings.negative: a negative association without the target coordinate, reported as such

masking_contrast.changed_constructs_check: on the cell-level input the constructs whose max |x| changes must equal D1's mapped_argmax_constructs (bioinf2027/diag/D1_target_in_features_external.csv); the run stops otherwise

mechanism: no D1b result tests mechanism for the twelve first-run objects, the encoder arm z, [z; m] or the controls C1 to C5; the masked max |x| score equals a masked MAX-LINEAR score for the stored fit and for any refit with the target zeroed whose slope stays positive, and such a refit belongs to D2
composition: no D1b result excludes a difference in composition between the subsets; B1, B2 native, the target-zeroed max |x|, the control-mean tertiles and the reduced construct sets are context, with no rule attached

bootstrap.unit: target gene, except the batch sensitivity table, which resamples batches
bootstrap.part_c: one joint draw per replicate for every object, baseline and subset; a family with several archived seeds is scored by the mean of its per-seed Spearman inside the replicate; the family-level statistic is the mean in-minus-out difference over the twelve first-run objects inside the replicate
bootstrap.multiplicity: intervals are not adjusted for the number of comparisons; part (c) is post hoc, including its family-level means, whose point values follow from the first-run table, except the primary masking contrast, one per screen, fixed before its values were computed (Section 12.1)
bootstrap.constant_predictor_convention: a predictor that is constant on a subset of a replicate (the zero-filled target coordinate outside the features) has its statistic set to 0 there

sample_sizes.n_rows: rows used by the statistic; a row is named in row_unit
sample_sizes.n_target_genes: distinct target genes among those rows
sample_sizes.totals: n_rows_in_split, n_rows_in_scope and their target-gene counterparts give the size of the whole split or screen
sample_sizes.selection: on VCC the rows with an own delta are those whose target gene is one of the 2,000 features; the features were chosen by variance across training-row deltas, so the training rows with a feature target are selected partly on the size of their own delta, and the three splits do not estimate one quantity

control_mean.VCC: mean log1p expression of the target gene over the control cells of the row's batch, the cells the label uses
control_mean.external: mean log1p expression of the target gene over the whole pooled control set, the population the label's control draws are taken from, not any one draw

definitions.negated_own_delta_over_control_mean: own delta divided by the control mean, both on the log1p scale, negated; a ratio of log1p means, not the fraction of transcript lost

own_delta.VCC: delta-HVG cache value at the target gene's feature position: mean log1p over the row's perturbed cells minus the mean log1p over that batch's control cells, same cells as the label; defined only where the target gene is one of the 2,000 features
own_delta.external: native cell-level delta at the target gene's column: mean log1p over all of the construct's eligible cells minus the mean log1p over the whole pooled control set, not the per-draw subsample the label uses

split_meaning.availability: the split is by whether the model's input contains the target coordinate
split_meaning.summary_availability: the input is four summaries of the 2,000 features; the target enters only through them, most directly through max |x|
split_meaning.positive_control_release: positive control for the twelve first-run objects: the target coordinate of the release pseudobulk they were scored on; zero where the target is not a feature, and its statistic set to 0 there by convention
split_meaning.positive_control_cell: positive control for the arms built on the cell-level delta (C2 and [z; m]): the target coordinate of that input; zero where the target is not a feature, and its statistic set to 0 there by convention
split_meaning.partly_availability: the magnitude part of the input is four summaries of the 2,000 features, so the target enters it only through them and its closer reference is the cell-level max |x| row; the encoder part sees most genes, so the split is only partly an availability split
split_meaning.not_availability: not an availability split: the encoder input contains most genes, including the target, whether or not it is one of the 2,000 features
split_meaning.null: the representation carries no information; a difference here is noise
split_meaning.baseline: trivial predictor computed without any model

definitions.seed_convention: named per row; no in-minus-out difference is compared across conventions
definitions.archived_objects: all were trained on the all-cells, batch-local source label of the submitted work; intervals are conditional on the archived predictions
